title: Pin Audit SARIF scanner and ruleset evidence
summary: Pin Audit SARIF scanner versions and the downloaded Semgrep ruleset, then embed their identities in SARIF and job summaries.
reason: Batch 190 remediates AUDIT-FIND-W10-008. Audit SARIF currently resolves broad scanner ranges and mutable p/default rules at run time, so repeated evidence for one commit is not attributable to fixed inputs.
behavior_before: The hosted lane installs ranged Ruff and Semgrep versions, scans directly with mutable p/default, and records no ruleset digest in SARIF provenance.
behavior_after: The hosted lane installs exact scanner versions, downloads p/default only through a verified SHA-256 lock, and records scanner and ruleset identities in both SARIF and job-summary evidence.
tests_added: Pinned ruleset download accepts only the exact SHA-256 and never replaces an existing output on mismatch.
SARIF stamping verifies the emitted scanner version and records deterministic scanner/ruleset provenance.
Workflow contract rejects version ranges, direct remote ruleset scans, missing digest verification, and missing summary provenance.
manual_validation: Run focused provenance/audit tests, YAML parsing, Ruff, py_compile, exact remote ruleset digest preflight, generated checks, strict packet coverage, and git diff --check.
Rung 6 remains pending until the pinned workflow is committed, pushed, run twice at one SHA, and normalized SARIF/tool identities compare equal.

validation_gates.description: Exact Ruff and Semgrep versions plus a SHA-256-verified Semgrep ruleset are enforced and recorded in SARIF/job-summary evidence.
evidence: Audit SARIF installs exact Ruff 0.16.1 and Semgrep 1.172.0 versions; ranged installs and direct --config p/default scanning are absent.

The workflow fetches p/default through the provenance helper, accepts only SHA-256 a7eb740a484688c0ba24668bb5fb7fc9a8ebc04c8eae982230d75f2ad9094bbc, scans the verified RUNNER_TEMP file, verifies each emitted SARIF driver version, and stamps scanner/ruleset identity for summaries and artifacts.

The prior 3be957c1c0f470ba18cfc2082663d39589a714c60ae365f0c7bd66aaa04fc6c6 lock failed closed during isolated pre-push validation without writing output. Two fresh identity-encoded downloads were byte-identical at 2,423,491 bytes and the refreshed a7eb740a484688c0ba24668bb5fb7fc9a8ebc04c8eae982230d75f2ad9094bbc digest; the helper then fetched and wrote those exact bytes successfully.
Focused provenance and audit-workflow tests passed 15 tests; the revision-local focused plus required generated-context suite passed 52 tests.

validation_gates.description: Two hosted Audit SARIF runs at one committed revision report identical tool identities and normalized SARIF.
evidence: Acceptance requires two Audit SARIF runs at the exact pushed Batch 190 head SHA, artifact download, and equality of audit_sarif_provenance digest-sarif output for each scanner including embedded provenance.

rollback_plan: Restore ranged scanner installs and direct p/default scanning, remove the provenance helper/tests, regenerate context, and revert this packet. No runtime or media behavior changes.
notes: The exact 2,000-token context slice and no-touch boundary were read. This is release/audit evidence tooling, not release-package contents or media behavior; representative real media is not required. The validation rung is Rung 6 two-run audit-evidence comparison. The isolated Batch 190 canary intentionally excludes the earlier uncommitted AUDIT-FIND-W10-007 adjudication changes, their helper/tests, and all unrelated primary-worktree changes. Scanner pins remain Ruff 0.16.1 and Semgrep 1.172.0, matching successful scheduled Audit SARIF run 30741529429 on 2026-08-02. During isolated pre-push validation on 2026-08-03, the former p/default lock 3be957c1c0f470ba18cfc2082663d39589a714c60ae365f0c7bd66aaa04fc6c6 failed closed because the registry bytes had changed; two fresh identity-encoded downloads were byte-identical at 2,423,491 bytes and SHA-256 a7eb740a484688c0ba24668bb5fb7fc9a8ebc04c8eae982230d75f2ad9094bbc, which became the refreshed lock.
